source_tree_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON source_hashes with sorted keys/separators(',',':').
initial_state: Empty native GUI project. All construction is original; no project fixture import.
actions: Launch the separately identified candidate after this declaration is frozen.
Create Curve A and Curve B rectangles: width 0.4 m, height 0.6 m, pattern origins [0,0] and [1,0]. Keep both default zero 3D placements.
Select Curve A top boundary ID 9, enable cubic controls and enter P1=[0.3,0.8], P2=[0.1,0.8] m.
Sew to Curve B top boundary ID 18 with reversed full intervals, then save before-split.weftforge.
Split retained curve ID 9 at curve parameter t=0.4, then save after-split.weftforge.
Focus first-child P1 X without editing, then save after-focus.weftforge. Refocus P1 X immediately before Join if the save changes focus.
Activate Join with next boundary for the retained first child, then save after-join.weftforge.
Press Tab to expose any old child numeric text replay, then save after-join-tab.weftforge.
Invoke one Undo and save join-undone.weftforge; invoke one Redo and save join-redone.weftforge.
Change resolution to 0.09 m, save coarse.weftforge and export coarse.obj/coarse.svg from this accepted construction.
Change resolution to 0.035 m, save fine.weftforge and export fine.obj/fine.svg from this accepted construction.
Quit the native process, relaunch the same identified candidate, reopen fine.weftforge and save reopened.weftforge.
Select a rectangle corner boundary, attempt Join with next boundary, retain the visible validation error and save after-corner-error.weftforge.
Retain UI observations/screenshots and process/executable identity in a separate parent record; no evaluator or CLI-generated project substitutes for native snapshots.

criteria.proof_method: Exact rational power-basis restrictions of serialized decimal controls. Max squared Bernstein control difference bounds every parameter; no sample-only acceptance.
criteria.discover_split_ids: Exact point/curve/seam ID set differences after validating baseline IDs.
criteria.join_identity: Retain selected curve/start point; retire second child and shared point; allocate/reuse no IDs.
criteria.seam_identity: Keep both split seam records, IDs, names, order and normalized correspondence. Only child-side curve references and affine interval endpoints may change.
criteria.one_transaction: Split, successful Join, Undo, Redo and each resolution edit each advance exactly one revision.
criteria.undo_redo_construction: Undo restores after-split construction, Redo restores after-join construction; compare all fields except revision and reserved next_id. Allocator remains monotone and Redo allocates no IDs.
criteria.reopen_construction: Restore all fine construction fields; revision and next_id excluded from equality, with next_id separately required unchanged.
criteria.no_change_focus_bytes: after-focus.weftforge must be byte-identical to after-split.weftforge.
criteria.no_stale_buffer_replay_bytes: after-join-tab.weftforge must be byte-identical to after-join.weftforge.
criteria.corner_rejection_bytes: after-corner-error.weftforge must be byte-identical to reopened.weftforge.
criteria.unintended_changes: All pieces, placements, grain, materials, mannequin, unrelated curves/points and document fields remain exact outside declared changes.
criteria.refinement: Only revision/resolution changes. Fine mesh must increase vertices; all OBJ triangle areas/UV areas are positive, normals/winding/indices valid and metre scale preserved.
criteria.svg: Two closed editable piece paths, exactly one retained editable cubic after Join, millimetre units and all control geometry within the same absolute bound.

allowed_reads: original sewn-curve evaluator and fixture evidence
prohibited_reads_actions: No new Rust join/UI implementation read
synthetic_self_checks: 1e-6 m stale SVG cache geometry rejection

limitations: No reference interaction or parity claim.
No cloth fitting or simulation quality claim.
Both placements remain default zero: pattern and world geometry norms coincide. No large-translation native coverage.
No native coalesced-event UI coverage; source tests cover that separate case.
Saved files cannot prove GUI gesture identity, actual input focus/event timing, displayed error text or executing-process attribution. Parent observations are required.
publication_gate: Private until native outputs exist and privacy review completes. Every eventual published artifact must be Git-tracked and registry/map checks run from a clean checkout.
